page: Amazon Web Services m6id.24xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8375C processor with 96 vCPUs (48 physical cores) running at 3.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 384.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage consists of 5700 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 38 Gbps. There are no GPUs on this instance.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities and memory throughput. The server achieves a strong rating in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores. Memory bandwidth is also strong, reaching 4972.07 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 329.31 GB/sec for large-block reads. Cryptographic capabilities are highly efficient, with the PassMark CPU encryption test scoring in the top tier at 86161.03, aided by hardware-accelerated AES and VAES instruction sets.

While multi-threaded execution and database operations are strong, single-core performance remains average, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1672.0. Large-scale LLM text generation is a notable bottleneck, with the 70B model text generation benchmark falling into the weak category at 2.58 tokens per second. Consequently, this server is suited for multi-threaded workloads, database operations, static web serving, and software compilation, rather than large-model text generation.
